name: Dropdown
purpose: Lets a user choose one or more options from a list. Comes in a non-native (custom, fully styled) family and a native (browser select) family. The trigger opens a list; items can be single-select, filterable single-select, or multi-select.

props.name: family
props.$note: non-native = custom styled menu; native = OS/browser select control.

props.name: open
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C9 -- no-bind:behavioural. Behavioural/content-presence state, no token consequence. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: state
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C1 -- no-bind:state-selector. A state enum selects among per-state token SETS (colour-semantic); per-state maps are the colour-spine lane's job (not yet migrated). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: itemState
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C1 -- no-bind:state-selector. A state enum selects among per-state token SETS (colour-semantic); per-state maps are the colour-spine lane's job (not yet migrated). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

variants.name: filterable single-select (non-native)
variants.use: Custom dropdown with a filter/search field; adds an 'active message' state.

variants.name: multi-select (non-native)
variants.use: Custom dropdown, multiple options (checkbox-style list items).

tokens.type: font-5 (medium label / light value); native menu items font-6/regular
tokens.error: rag/error (and an inner-shadow 'bottom stroke' for the error field)

accessibility.keyboard: REVIEW (inferred): full keyboard operation — open/close, arrow navigation, type-ahead, Enter/Escape; native family inherits browser behaviour
accessibility.roles: REVIEW (inferred): non-native must implement combobox/listbox semantics (aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, option roles, aria-selected); prefer native where possible for robustness
accessibility.states: Disabled and error states exposed programmatically; error not conveyed by colour/inner-shadow alone — pair with a message (the 'active message'/error message states exist)

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): using a non-native dropdown without full combobox keyboard/ARIA support where native would be more robust
Conveying error via the red bottom-stroke alone without an error message
Leaving the trigger bound to deprecated interactive/* surface & border tokens — migrate to the form/* family (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS (values resolve) — significant deprecated usage on the triggers; the live form/* family is the migration target

depricateUsage.summary: Non-native trigger uses form/* for most states but still binds a few deprecated tokens; the NATIVE trigger is less migrated and binds interactive (depricate)/* surface+border heavily. List items are clean.
depricateUsage.migrationPath: Most have clean form/* (or rag/error, icon/default) rebinds — migrate the dropdown triggers, especially the NATIVE family, onto the form/* token set. Only the two non-interactive surface neutrals need a confirmed target.
depricateUsage.notExhaustive: Filterable single-select and multi-select triggers not individually queried — expected similar to single-select non-native.
